blurb: Harbour Air operates scheduled seaplane flights connecting multiple destinations including Vancouver, Nanaimo, Victoria, Comox, Tofino, Powell River, Salt Spring Island, Sechelt, and Seattle. They offer various fare classes with different baggage allowances and flexibility options. Scenic tours are also available with different fare options including promo, standard, and ultimate.
extraNote: Booking fee of CAD$15 per transaction if booked via Customer Contact Centre when self-serve was possible · Fares are non-refundable and non-changeable for Everyday Low Fare booked less than 45 days in advance · Cancellation and change policies vary by fare class; Light fare is non-refundable, Value and Comfort fares refundable to HA credit with fees, Flex fare refundable to original payment · Downtown Vancouver, Vancouver Airport (YVR South Seaplane Terminal), Victoria, Nanaimo, Comox, Tofino terminals
